A [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] '''family''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] had an extended history of military service, with each [[Gender/Legends|male]] member participating in the [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|Gungan Grand Army]] in some capacity. [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]] was the first member of the family to reach the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the Grand Army, and as such became a hero to his clan. Tarpals downplayed his accomplishments and believed he was only performing his duties.<ref name="GB" /> Tarpals was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on Naboo while aiding the capture of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]<ref name="Shadow Warrior">{{TCW|Shadow Warrior}}</ref> in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].<ref name="TCW date">{{TCWdates|404}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Roos Tarpals' family was mentioned in that characters entry in the DataBank of the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.<ref name="GB" />
